Weight Loss
Up to two-thirds of patients with advanced cancer have some degree of weight loss. Studies have 
shown that of patients with cancer, 59 percent had decreased appetite, 67 percent had decreased 
food intake, and 54 percent were underweight. Patients with the highest weight loss were those
